auth.password_hint: At least 8 characters. Avoid common passwords.

start.error_hint: Make sure the backend is running and your phone is on the same Wi-Fi.

join.title: Where's home?
join.intro: We use your address once to find your neighborhood, then forget it.
join.address_forgotten: Your address was used once to find your neighborhood and wasn't saved.

setup.title: Set up your profile
setup.privacy_note: Neighbors see your first name and last initial only.
setup.photo_failed: Your profile is saved, but the photo didn't upload. {{reason}}

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.timeout: The server is taking too long to answer. Check your connection and try again.
errors.server_error: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.throttled: That's a lot of tries in a short time. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.invalid: Please check what you entered and try again.
errors.no_match: We couldn't find that address. Check the spelling and try again.
errors.outside_denver: {{app}} is only in the City and County of Denver for now.
errors.geocoder_unavailable: We can't look up addresses right now. Please try again in a minute.
errors.email_taken: An account with this email already exists. Try logging in.
errors.password_too_short: Your password needs at least 8 characters.
errors.password_too_common: That password is too common. Try a longer phrase.
errors.password_entirely_numeric: Your password can't be only numbers.
errors.password_too_similar: Your password is too much like your email.
errors.invalid_alias: That isn't one of this neighborhood's names.
errors.unknown_interest: One of those interests isn't on the list.
errors.photo_too_large: Photos must be 5 MB or smaller.
errors.photo_wrong_type: Photos must be JPEG or PNG.
errors.bad_image: Screenshots must be a JPEG or PNG of 5 MB or less.
errors.daily_limit: You've sent a lot of reports today. Please try again tomorrow.

demo.banner_text: real Denver map · sample addresses · stays in this browser
demo.samples_body: Samples use their real locations and Denver's official neighborhood map. The demo can't look up other addresses, but it recognizes Denver neighborhood names you type, like "Five Points".

coming_soon.title: Coming soon
coming_soon.body: We're still writing this page. Check back before the app launches.

report.title: Report a problem
report.message_placeholder: Tell us what you were doing and what went wrong.
report.what_we_send: We also send your app version, phone model, language and this screen's name, so we can find the problem. Never your address or location.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.warning: This permanently deletes your profile, photo and login. It can't be undone.
